compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3b: gating hooks short-circuit (test-gate + test-quality-gate portion) — pre-commit-test-gate.sh and pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh source enforcement-gate.sh and short-circuit with HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci on ci

## Description
Apply the same pattern as Task 3 to plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-gate.sh and plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh. After existing trap setup, source enforcement-gate.sh and call `_dso_enforcement_gate_check && exit 0` before any test-association or grep work. Single commit covers both files since they share the verification path.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-gate.sh (modify)
- plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh (modify)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] All gating hooks source enforcement-gate.sh
  Verify: test "$(grep -l 'enforcement-gate.sh' plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-gate.sh plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh | wc -l)" -eq 3
- [ ] Full enforcement-gate test suite passes
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh
- [ ] Always-on hooks remain unmodified (no enforcement-gate.sh sourcing)
  Verify: ! grep -q 'enforcement-gate.sh' plugins/dso/scripts/check-portability.sh plugins/dso/scripts/check-shim-refs.sh plugins/dso/scripts/check-contract-schemas.sh plugins/dso/scripts/check-referential-integrity.sh plugins/dso/scripts/check-plugin-self-ref.sh plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-enforcement-boundary-check.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
